en-US.author: Los Broxas
en-US.description: A game launcher with its own embedded BitTorrent client.
en-US.longDescription: Hydra is a Game Launcher with its own embedded BitTorrent Client. The launcher is written in TypeScript (Electron) and Python, which handles the torrenting system by using libtorrent.
en-US.name: Hydra
